messages:
Alex G: quick heads-up — i'm taking the EMEA overnight primary from 22:00->06:00 UTC but i have a 2h travel window 00:30-02:30 UTC. coverage gap for ~2h. need a short coverage bridge or pager fallback. not an incident yet, just planning.

Maria S: thanks for flagging. can you share the exact hours you can be reached on phone if something pops up?

Alex G: i'll be reachable via phone until boarding (00:15). during 00:30-02:30 i might be slow (>10m response). i can still ack pages from pagerduty but might be delayed.

Jamal R: i can take secondary to be ready to escalate into primary if you don't ack. i'll be on-call in APAC too so timezone aligns. tagging @pagerduty-bot to set temporary escalation override.

Priya N: copy — for clarity, follow the temporary coverage procedure in runbook 4.2 (link below). short checklist: 1) set PD override to route to Jamal as primary during gap, 2) set 'coverage-bridge' tag in incident channel, 3) document any customer-impacting changes.

Alex G: putting runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/4.2-coverage-bridge (useful snippet below)

Priya N: runbook snippet: ```
# Temporary Coverage Bridge
- Step 1: Oncall initiator opens thread and pings #eng-oncall
- Step 2: Primary sets PD override: `pd override add --to jamal --from 00:30 --to 02:30`
- Step 3: Secondary acknowledges in thread and confirms monitoring watches
- Step 4: If no ack from primary < 5m -> secondary assumes active paging
- Escalation timeline: ack <=5m then normal; no ack -> escalate to secondary; 15m -> eng-leads paged; 30m -> exec notify
```

incident-bot: New pager created: latency_spike_api (severity: P2) — 5m elevated 95th latency in eu-west-1. link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-211223-1

Maria S: seeing small blip on dashboards. error rate stable. CC: @Priya N for impact assessment.

Priya N: quick customer impact rubric: 
- Sev1: customer-visible outage affecting >5% revenue or >10% users, or data loss. immediate everyone-page.
- Sev2: partial impact, significant latency or feature degradation for subset. page on-call + oncall-leads.
- Sev3: minor/none customer impact — ticket and followup.

Jamal R: acked PD page. i'm watching metrics and adding an extra trace filter to check retry counts. if this turns into SLO breach (>2% error over 5m for gen-api) escalate to Sev1.

Alex G: thanks jamal. i ran the quick health check: `scripts/health-check.sh eu-west-1` returned: ```
OK: all workers responding
WARN: queue depth increased to 120 (norm 40)
```

Maria S: looks like queue buildup. possible autoscaler miss. @eng-runtime oncall FYI.

Jamal R: manual scaling command (if autoscaler fails): `k scale deployment gen-workers --replicas=40 -n inference-eu` — do this only if CPU >= 85% and queue > 100 for 3mins.

Priya N: escalation rules (short): 
- P0/P1 (outage/data loss): page `eng-oncall` + `eng-leads` + `cto`; immediate zoom bridge.
- P2 (degraded): page `eng-oncall`; if no ack in 5m escalate to `secondary-oncall`; 15m escalate to `eng-leads`.
- P3 (info): async ticket + note.

Alex G: making PD override now: `pd override add --to jamal --from 00:30 --to 02:30 --note "overnight travel coverage"`

pagerduty-bot: Override created by Alex G for user Jamal R (00:30 - 02:30 UTC).

Jamal R: confirmed. i'll be primary for the window. i'll post status check every 30m.

Maria S: quick reminder about ack expectations: ack within 5m of page. if paging to stack-level escalations (eg runtime), call the on-call in addition to PD page for critical incidents.

Priya N: customer comms guidance: if Sev2 persists >30m affecting SLAs, draft a short status note and ask support to notify affected customers (use template: https://internal.redwood/templates/customer-status).

Alex G: thanks team and sorry for the short notice. leaving notes in handoff doc now. https://internal.redwood/handoffs/211223-alex -> added checklists and links to dashboards.

Jamal R: cool. if anything spikes while you're in transit i'll take it. ping me on mobile if PD page doesn't go through. :phone: :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident INC-211223-1 updated: severity remains P2; assignee: Jamal R; last update 00:45 UTC.

Maria S: closing loop — created a follow-up ticket to investigate autoscaler thresholds (TKT-5478). tagging eng-runtime squad.

Priya N: logged the coverage bridge and escalation decisions in the incident timeline. all set. good travel, Alex.

Alex G: thanks — appreciate the coverage. back online at ~02:40 UTC.
